items.claim: Neil Magny has been caught in front chokes throughout his career.
items.quote: Neil Magny has been caught in some front chokes throughout his career.

items.claim: Neil Magny will be able to hold down Ramis Brahimage if he gets top position.
items.quote: You don't think Neil Magny if he gets top positions going to be able to hold down Ramis Brahimage? I think he will.

items.claim: Ramis Brahimage lost to Ponelli Soraniano in his last fight by being dominated in the grappling over three rounds.
items.quote: He lost to Penelli Soraniano in his last fight. So did Uros Medic lose to Ponelli Soraniano by KO. But he got dominated over three rounds in the grappling. Just held down over three rounds.

items.claim: Lucas Fernando has an 80-inch reach compared to Raphael Tobias's 74.5-inch reach.
items.quote: 80in reach compared to a 74.5 in reach.

items.claim: Lucas Fernando is much bigger than Raphael Tobias and will look like the bigger dude.
items.quote: Lucas Fernando's very athletic, very big, way bigger than Raphael Tobias.

items.claim: Tjon Gore has a solid chin and can take punches very well.
items.quote: Tawn Gore's got a solid chin, man. and he's a scrapper... Tong Gore takes some wopups on the chin and he takes him pretty well.
